{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"公司报告期内主营业务为珠宝服务业务及商业综合体运营与物业租赁业务，划分为珠宝产业板块与物理平台板块两大板块。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"珠宝产业板块下分珠宝交易板块与黄金板块：珠宝交易板块致力于建立数字化珠宝要素交易平台，报告期内平台正式上线；黄金板块以黄金为载体、以中国优秀传统文化为内涵，提供定制化产品解决方案。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F03","text":"物理平台板块高效运营公司持有的物业资源，推动由传统空间租赁向以客户为中心的商业资产运营服务转变。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F04","text":"公司按内部报告制度将经营业务划分为珠宝销售及服务（黄金珠宝批发和零售）、租赁及服务（房产及商业地产租赁）2个报告分部。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F05","text":"珠宝业务以黄金、珠宝为主要销售品类，采用批发、零售模式，同时提供代理报关、黄金提纯/兑换等配套服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F06","text":"珠宝交易板块数字化平台实现线上商城、看货会、供应链管理、分销系统等功能，构建线上展示、交易、结算闭环，并应用于珍珠看货会及卖场管理。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0003"]},{"fact_id":"F07","text":"子公司国润黄金（深圳）有限公司主要业务为投资金条销售、黄金回收、黄金提纯/兑换服务。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"]},{"fact_id":"F08","text":"子公司深圳珠宝产业服务有限公司主要业务为珠宝展销会策划、珠宝寄售、展览展示策划、会务服务、市场营销策划。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F09","text":"珠宝业务按销售模式分为批发、零售及其他服务，2025年批发营业收入53,111.14万元、零售额59,138.24万元、其他服务939.50万元，合计113,188.88万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"珠宝业务批发营业收入","raw_value":"53,111.14","value":"53111.14","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务零售额营业收入","raw_value":"59,138.24","value":"59138.24","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务其他服务营业收入","raw_value":"939.50","value":"939.50","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务销售收入合计","raw_value":"113,188.88","value":"113188.88","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F10","text":"珠宝业务各销售模式毛利率：批发3.91%、零售3.84%、其他服务57.50%，合计4.32%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"珠宝业务批发毛利率","raw_value":"3.91","value":"3.91","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务零售毛利率","raw_value":"3.84","value":"3.84","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务其他服务毛利率","raw_value":"57.50","value":"57.50","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝业务销售毛利率合计","raw_value":"4.32","value":"4.32","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F11","text":"公司营业收入全部为直接销售模式，2025年直接销售收入1,461,603,400.53元，占营业收入100.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"直接销售营业收入","raw_value":"1,461,603,400.53","value":"1461603400.53","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F12","text":"2025年公司实现营业收入146,160万元，同比减少44.08%，收入变动主要原因是公司主动调整黄金业务模式等。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"146,160","value":"146160","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-44.08","value":"-44.08","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F13","text":"2025年公司实现利润总额17,506万元，归属于母公司净利润14,287万元，比2024年增加624万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"利润总额","raw_value":"17,506","value":"17506","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"归属于母公司净利润","raw_value":"14,287","value":"14287","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"归属于母公司净利润同比增加额","raw_value":"624","value":"624","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F14","text":"按行业/产品分，2025年珠宝销售及服务营业收入1,131,888,850.11元，占营业收入77.44%；租赁及服务营业收入329,714,550.42元，占22.56%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"珠宝销售及服务营业收入","raw_value":"1,131,888,850.11","value":"1131888850.11","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝销售及服务占营业收入比重","raw_value":"77.44","value":"77.44","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"租赁及服务营业收入","raw_value":"329,714,550.42","value":"329714550.42","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"租赁及服务占营业收入比重","raw_value":"22.56","value":"22.56","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F15","text":"2025年珠宝销售及服务毛利率4.27%（同比增2.23个百分点），租赁及服务毛利率61.02%（同比减3.67个百分点）。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"珠宝销售及服务毛利率","raw_value":"4.27","value":"4.27","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝销售及服务毛利率同比增减","raw_value":"2.23","value":"2.23","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"租赁及服务毛利率","raw_value":"61.02","value":"61.02","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"租赁及服务毛利率同比增减","raw_value":"-3.67","value":"-3.67","unit":"百分点","source_unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F16","text":"分部信息显示，2025年租赁及服务分部营业收入332,053,853.84元，珠宝批发及零售服务分部营业收入1,132,159,330.29元，分部间抵销-2,609,783.60元，合计1,461,603,400.53元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012"],"metrics":[{"name":"租赁及服务分部营业收入","raw_value":"332,053,853.84","value":"332053853.84","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珠宝批发及零售服务分部营业收入","raw_value":"1,132,159,330.29","value":"1132159330.29","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"分部间抵销营业收入","raw_value":"-2,609,783.60","value":"-2609783.60","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F17","text":"按地区分，2025年华南地区营业收入943,760,912.51元占64.57%，华中地区243,245,121.80元占16.64%，华东地区173,615,831.08元占11.88%，北方地区77,242,667.32元占5.28%，其他地区23,738,867.82元占1.62%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"华南地区营业收入","raw_value":"943,760,912.51","value":"943760912.51","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"华中地区营业收入","raw_value":"243,245,121.80","value":"243245121.80","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"华东地区营业收入","raw_value":"173,615,831.08","value":"173615831.08","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"北方地区营业收入","raw_value":"77,242,667.32","value":"77242667.32","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"其他地区营业收入","raw_value":"23,738,867.82","value":"23738867.82","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]}]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F18","text":"黄金及其制品主要采用委托加工模式，钻石彩宝等不涉及加工；2025年委托加工成品金额107,558.50万元，占比100.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"委托加工成品金额","raw_value":"107,558.50","value":"107558.50","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"委托加工成品占比","raw_value":"100.00","value":"100.00","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F19","text":"采购模式：黄金及其制品向上海黄金交易所或具备资质的单位购买黄金原材料，或向银行租借；其它珠宝玉石向境内外珠宝玉石供应商采购产品。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F20","text":"2025年现货交易采购黄金1,384.50KG、采购金额104,375.00万元；采购珍珠15,287.00粒、采购金额276.42万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"黄金现货交易采购数量","raw_value":"1,384.50","value":"1384.50","unit":"KG","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"黄金现货交易采购金额","raw_value":"104,375.00","value":"104375.00","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珍珠现货交易采购数量","raw_value":"15,287.00","value":"15287.00","unit":"粒","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珍珠现货交易采购金额","raw_value":"276.42","value":"276.42","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F21","text":"截至2025年12月31日，公司珠宝业务存货余额5,965.75万元，其中以公允价值计量的金额为4,917.84万元，系以商品期货合约及T+D合约作为套期工具的被套期项目。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025-12-31","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"珠宝业务存货余额","raw_value":"5,965.75","value":"5965.75","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025-12-31"},{"name":"珠宝业务以公允价值计量存货金额","raw_value":"4,917.84","value":"4917.84","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025-12-31"}]},{"fact_id":"F22","text":"2025年黄金批发及零售销售量1,561.66KG、生产量1,498.59KG、库存量53.98KG；珍珠批发及零售销售量2,641.00粒、库存量12,646.00粒、采购量15,287.00粒。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"黄金批发及零售销售量","raw_value":"1,561.66","value":"1561.66","unit":"KG","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"黄金批发及零售生产量","raw_value":"1,498.59","value":"1498.59","unit":"KG","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"黄金批发及零售库存量","raw_value":"53.98","value":"53.98","unit":"KG","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珍珠批发及零售销售量","raw_value":"2,641.00","value":"2641.00","unit":"粒","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珍珠批发及零售库存量","raw_value":"12,646.00","value":"12646.00","unit":"粒","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"珍珠批发及零售采购量","raw_value":"15,287.00","value":"15287.00","unit":"粒","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]}]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F23","text":"珠宝业务实体直营门店：国润直营店（特力）一楼营业收入768.22万元、营业成本733.68万元；国润（特力）负一楼柜台营业收入5,539.48万元、营业成本5,331.50万元；国润（特力）负一楼边厅营业收入46.16万元、营业成本44.39万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"国润直营店（特力）一楼营业收入","raw_value":"768.22","value":"768.22","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"国润（特力）负一楼柜台营业收入","raw_value":"5,539.48","value":"5539.48","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"国润（特力）负一楼边厅营业收入","raw_value":"46.16","value":"46.16","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F24","text":"珠宝业务线上销售主要平台：阿里平台店铺营业收入19,673.34万元、鲸芽平台16,084.20万元、京东平台店铺7,212.49万元、拼多多平台店铺5,790.50万元、小程序商城3,792.37万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"],"metrics":[{"name":"阿里平台店铺营业收入","raw_value":"19,673.34","value":"19673.34","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"鲸芽平台营业收入","raw_value":"16,084.20","value":"16084.20","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"京东平台店铺营业收入","raw_value":"7,212.49","value":"7212.49","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"拼多多平台店铺营业收入","raw_value":"5,790.50","value":"5790.50","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"小程序商城营业收入","raw_value":"3,792.37","value":"3792.37","unit":"万元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F25","text":"2025年前五名客户合计销售金额416,005,660.48元，占年度销售总额比例28.46%，其中关联方销售额占比0.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名客户合计销售金额","raw_value":"416,005,660.48","value":"416005660.48","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"前五名客户合计销售金额占年度销售总额比例","raw_value":"28.46","value":"28.46","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]},{"fact_id":"F26","text":"2025年前五名供应商合计采购金额1,125,996,365.70元，占年度采购总额比例94.87%；报告期内占公司年度采购总额比例超50%的供应商是上海黄金交易所。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名供应商合计采购金额","raw_value":"1,125,996,365.70","value":"1125996365.70","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"},{"name":"前五名供应商合计采购金额占年度采购总额比例","raw_value":"94.87","value":"94.87","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度"}]}]},"operating_drivers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F27","text":"珠宝交易板块数字化平台已准入多家供应商，注册用户超200名；公司打造水贝首个非洲翠专业市场，引入上游源头供应商，试点推广数字化交易平台。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"平台注册用户数","raw_value":"超200
